$description: SEMANTIC component-size intents: the load-bearing container / min dimensions that live inside components (min-width / max-width / min-height), named by INTENT rather than raw px. Distinct from the core 4px `space` scale (padding/gap/margin) and the `icon` glyph scale: these are off-grid, component-specific footprints (a menu's comfortable width, a chart tooltip's minimum, the a11y touch target). Stored in px; the Compose build emits dp, Swift emits pt, the same platform-unit treatment as radius/space. Bind via var(--size-*).

minTouch.$description: Minimum interactive touch-target dimension (a11y). The single-line field / control min-height.

dividerSignature.$description: Thickness of the SIGNATURE divider, the accentPrimary line both apps drew at a hardcoded 1.5 (S6). Pairs with color.accentPrimary; the plain neutral divider stays 1px hairline.

chartMin.$description: Minimum width of an in-chart readout (line-chart hover tooltip) so short values don't collapse.

panelMin.$description: Minimum height of a content panel (tab panel) so an empty/short panel keeps a stable footprint.

selectMaxHeight.$description: Max height of the NockerlSelect popover list before it caps + scrolls; grows to fit short lists (Voice's provider picker clipped one row at the old 300).

container.$description: Comfortable container widths for self-clamped overlays / narrow layout columns: the menu / tooltip / popover / stepper footprints. Off the 4px grid on purpose (ergonomic reading widths, not spacing).

md.$description: Medium container: popover width / menu max-width.

chat.$description: CHAT-SURFACE width caps, the adaptive/max-width pass. The proven message-column geometry, shared by web + Compose so folded (360dp) / unfolded (840dp) / tablet / wide web all clamp identically: content NEVER stretches edge-to-edge on wide chat surfaces.

bubbleMax.$description: Max width of a chat bubble AND the chat-input pill (the input aligns with the message column, centered on wide). Web formula stays min(82%, bubbleMax).

toolCardMax.$description: Max width of a standalone tool-call card (inside a bubble it fills the bubble's content width instead).

bannerMax.$description: Max width of an inline banner alert on wide surfaces (Android fillMaxWidth adopts this cap).

columnMax.$description: The whole chat COLUMN's cap on very wide surfaces. Tokenizes Android's proven TABLET_LANDSCAPE_COLUMN_CAP_DP (1040).
